PZZ700-142130-
1240 AM PST Sat Nov 14 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...At 1 AM, a 972 mb low 
was about 1035 nautical miles west of Seattle Washington and a 
1001 mb low was over Nevada, with a frontal boundary extending to
the southwest over Southern California. Strong southwesterly 
winds will continue through this morning. Swell and wind waves 
will increase today. Winds and seas slowly diminish late today 
through Sunday before increasing again on Monday as the next 
weather system arrives.

$$

PZZ740-142130-
Coastal Waters from San Mateo Point to the Mexican Border and out
to 10 nm-
1240 AM PST Sat Nov 14 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON...

.TODAY...Wind W 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Seas 7 to 8 ft...
subsiding to 5 to 7 ft this afternoon. Wave Detail: W 6 ft at
6 seconds and SW 2 ft at 15 seconds...subsiding to NW 1 foot at
4 seconds, W 5 ft at 7 seconds and S 2 ft at 15 seconds. A chance
of showers, mainly this morning. 
.TONIGHT...Wind variable less than 10 kt...becoming E 10 kt after
midnight. Seas 4 to 6 ft. Wave Detail: W 1 foot at 4 seconds, W
5 ft at 17 seconds and S 2 ft at 17 seconds. 
.SUN...Wind SE 10 kt...becoming NW in the afternoon. Seas 4 to
6 ft. Wave Detail: NE 1 foot at 4 seconds, W 4 ft at 16 seconds
and S 2 ft at 17 seconds. 
.SUN NIGHT...Wind N 10 kt in the evening...becoming variable less
than 10 kt. Seas 3 to 4 ft. Wave Detail: NW 1 foot at 4 seconds,
W 3 ft at 15 seconds and S 2 ft at 15 seconds. 
.MON...Wind N 10 kt...becoming W in the afternoon. Seas 3 to
5 ft. Wave Detail: N 1 foot at 4 seconds, S 2 ft at 15 seconds
and W 4 ft at 18 seconds. A slight chance of showers in the
morning, then a chance of showers in the afternoon. 
.MON NIGHT...Wind W 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Seas 5 to
6 ft...building to 8 to 10 ft after midnight. W 9 ft at 7 seconds
and S 2 ft at 14 seconds. Showers likely. 
.TUE...Wind NW 15 to 20 kt. Seas 8 to 11 ft. Wave Detail: W 9 ft
at 7 seconds and S 2 ft at 14 seconds. A chance of showers in the
morning. 
.TUE NIGHT...Wind NW 15 to 20 kt...becoming N 10 kt after
midnight. Seas 7 to 10 ft...subsiding to 6 to 8 ft after
midnight. Wave Detail: W 8 ft at 7 seconds and S 1 foot at
13 seconds...subsiding to NW 2 ft at 4 seconds, W 7 ft at
7 seconds and S 1 foot at 13 seconds. 
.WED...Wind E 10 kt in the morning...becoming variable less than
10 kt. Seas 4 to 6 ft. Wave Detail: N 1 foot at 4 seconds, W 5 ft
at 8 seconds and S 1 foot at 13 seconds. 
.WED NIGHT...Wind NW 10 to 15 kt. Seas 3 to 5 ft. Wave Detail: NW
4 ft at 5 seconds and S 1 foot at 12 seconds. A slight chance of
showers in the evening, then a chance of showers after midnight. 

$$
